program_name: Bachelor of Science (Hons) Psychology and Cognitive Neuroscience

fees.notes: International annual tuition fee for the 2026 intake (fixed for programme duration); 6% SST applies to international students from 1 July 2025. Source: https://www.nottingham.edu.my/Applications/Fees/UG.aspx (fetched 2026-09-18)

requirements.general: Any one of these: A Level BCC in either arts or science subjects (excluding Critical Thinking and General Studies). A Level Psychology is not required. International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Minimum of 24 points overall. STPM Grades of BC + C+ (excluding Pengajian Am). Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) 3 B3s and 2 B4s (excluding Bahasa Malaysia and Chinese Language). Australian Year 12 ATAR of 78, with relevant subjects considered. Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD) 75% average across 6 subjects. Canadian Secondary School Diplomas (Other Provinces) Accepted and assessed based on university requirements. China (Gaokao and Senior High School Diploma) 68% average in Gaokao (converted from 750 scale). 70% overall in the Senior High School Diploma, including 80% in Mathematics and 70% in a science subject. India (CBSE / CISCE - Class XII) 75% average in the best four subjects, excluding local language, Environmental Education, General Studies, and Physical Education. Advanced Placement (AP) Minimum scores of 4, 3, 3 in relevant subjects. Diploma (Local Institutions) Entry to Year 2 assessed on a case-by-case basis. Typically requires a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or higher and strong performance in relevant subjects. Foundation (Local Institutions) Minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 with good grades in relevant subjects. Subject to School’s discretion. Nottingham Foundation Programme Successful completion with a minimum average of 50%. Additional Requirement Grade B in Mathematics and a credit in a science subject at SPM, GCSE, IGCSE, High School Diploma, or equivalent. This may be waived if similar or higher-level qualifications have been achieved. English Language Requirements IELTS (Academic) Overall 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in each element. TOEFL (iBT) Minimum score of 90 Writing: 19 Listening: 19 Reading: 20 Speaking: 22 PTE (Academic) Overall 71 with no less than 65 in each element. GCE A Level / AS Level (English Language or Literature) Grade C SPM CEFR Level B2 GCSE O-Level Grade C / 4 IGCSE (First Language) Grade C / 4 IGCSE (Second Language) Grade B / 6 MUET Band 4.5 UEC Grade A2 IB English English A1 or A2 (SL/HL): 4 points English B (HL): 4 points English B (SL): 5 points OSSD English (ENG3U/ENG4U) Minimum 75% Must complete all 30 standard credits (no fast-track or exemptions). CBSE / CISCE (Class X or XII) Minimum 75% in English A confirmation letter is required stating English was the medium of instruction from Class X to XII. Important Notes: IELTS One Skill Retake is accepted. IELTS Academic Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, and PTE Academic Online are not accepted. MUET results are valid for 5 years from the release date. OSSD and CBSE/CISCE English results are only accepted with appropriate documentation of English as the medium of instruction. Fast-track or credit-exempted qualifications are not accepted for English proficiency validation.
